title: grid_fee docstrings say the module is free of Home Assistant imports; it cannot import without homeassistant
claim: grid_fee.py's module docstring (line 27, 'Kept free of Home Assistant imports so it can be unit-tested directly') and max_abs_component's docstring ('Pure and HA-free') are false: importing grid_fee with homeassistant absent raises ImportError, through currency.py's module-level `from homeassistant.core import HomeAssistant`.
mechanism: grid_fee imports currency.money_scale; currency imports homeassistant.core at module level for an annotation only (from __future__ import annotations makes it a string), so the HA-free property the docstring promises, and the reason it gives, fail transitively. The ten other HA-free claims in the cells hold.

evidence.unit: modules claiming HA-free that need homeassistant to import
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats running on the shared box; count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.grid_fee (module import, homeassistant refused by a meta-path finder; package __init__ bypassed)

perturbation.change: currency.py: move `from homeassistant.core import HomeAssistant` under `if TYPE_CHECKING:` (applied in memory by --perturb)

metric_definition: Count of cell modules whose comment claims freedom from Home Assistant imports yet whose import fails with every homeassistant module refused.
phenomenon_property: A comment that states a module is free of Home Assistant imports is true of the module's transitive import closure: the module imports with homeassistant absent.

null_control.value: 10 of 11 claimed modules import OK with homeassistant refused (flow_meter, flow_lift, diagnosis, freq_control, heat_energy, comfort_band, device_prefill, disinfection, inputs)
null_control.note: same refusal, same run: the instrument passes honest claims

reproduction_steps: run the command; read RESULT claimed_but_needs_ha=1 modules grid_fee
proposed_fix_scope: Either move currency.py's HomeAssistant import under TYPE_CHECKING (it is annotation-only) so the claim becomes true, or narrow the two grid_fee docstrings to 'no direct Home Assistant import'. The text_ledger row grid_fee.py#(module docstring) flips to true.
